requirements.acceptance: Armed civilian factions, militia retaliation, witness-based attribution, distant-town effects, morale, theft/aid reputation and failed-quest branches remain incomplete.

requirements.requirement: Multiple six-person squads act independently with real locations. G16,69.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Implemented**: `squads.js`, up to eight squads, strict co-location and squad tests. Formation now permits a chosen town with physically present personnel, even when another squad is marching. The labelled selector, exact location/route preservation, rejection and save cases pass; a live production-component check formed the actual San Nicolás reserve while the selected force remained in Tucumán. See [remote formation](remote-squad-formation.md).
requirements.acceptance: New work assignments, travel and tactical defense must not silently select or teleport another squad.

requirements.requirement: Travel is a queued process with route choice, arrival time, cancellation, and encounters. G71-73; M43-44.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Partial**: the map now schedules concurrent squad routes with waypoints, stage/destination ETA, real in-transit availability, stop-after-stage, timed reversal, save/reload, exhaustion pauses and same-hour arrival defenses. Contracts and hired mounts stay with travelers until a real arrival. See [queued travel](squad-travel.md). Squad rows and numbered map markers now start a read-only route preview. A second destination click or confirmation queues the actual route; Escape and right-click cancel only the draft. The compact desktop screen keeps the roster, map and clock together. Model, render and live two-squad checks cover this interface; see [map orders](strategic-map-orders.md).
requirements.acceptance: Hostile map orders now queue an adjacent approach and stop at the boundary. Ready squads may attack together, wait for later squads, or return over the distance already covered. Up to eight squads deploy through their real approach edges and remain separate after battle. See [coordinated attacks](coordinated-assault.md). Opposing-route contact now follows JA2's destination-sector model; see [route crossings](route-crossings.md). Initial hostile arrivals now have a saved placement screen with single-soldier/group selection, clear, spread and confirmation on each actual approach edge. Contact waits until confirmation; peaceful and resumed encounters retain their normal entry. See [sector arrival placement](sector-arrival-placement.md). Mid-battle arrival placement remains open. Fatigue stops after a stage follow the classic source; saved collapse now requires recovery before manual waking and route resumption. See [sleep evidence](sleep.md). Scripted attack orders can still use the blocking API. Travel hours and transport costs remain period-game tuning. Explicit multi-squad San Lorenzo assembly, southern arrival placement, return/save validation and live eight-person entry are now supported; see [mission squads](mission-squads.md).

requirements.requirement: Transport has capacity, operating cost, route restrictions, and recovery opportunities. G69,71-73.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Partial**: horses, postas, carts, mules and flotilla have strategic rules.
requirements.acceptance: Connect actual riders/cargo to capacity and passenger rest; tactical vehicle-like operation needs an appropriate period vehicle/vessel design.

requirements.requirement: The map exposes known enemy information, roads, locations, supplies, assignments, and time. G59-60,69-73.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Partial**: strategic panels cover much of this data. WebMCP preserves player resources, ownership, squads, hired/captured records, horses and the same observed/stale enemy reports displayed by the UI. It omits authoritative enemy rosters, future waypoints, RNG, pending deployment internals and stored tactical snapshots. Live projected reads and successful action responses worked; the actual post-care return showed patriot San Nicolás and the correct resident squad. See [live record](ja2-live-verification.md).
requirements.acceptance: Hidden-enemy and private-field exclusion remain pure-test evidence. Strategic summaries expose owned routes and in-transit status. Enemy reports now use [observed or stale sightings](enemy-intelligence.md); hidden groups, future routes and arrival schedules are not projected. Current/old reports, actual contact and save continuation pass simulation and live interface checks; authored static garrison intelligence remains separate. New fields default to private through explicit allowlists. This is a state-read/response boundary, not a new mutation-authorization system or proof of all map controls.

requirements.requirement: Dialogue offers approaches whose outcomes depend on the speaker and prior events. G29-31,75-106; M27-28.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Partial**: special characters, including non-recruitable quest and mission contacts, use a compact portrait/text/choices panel over the map. Ordinary civilians and enemies use brief varied replies without a conversation menu. J selects the talk cursor. Range, visibility, actor availability and actual campaign choices are enforced. Nine new tests, the full 1,450-test suite and live quest/speech/save checks pass; see [dialogue interface](npc-dialogue.md). Special panels now replay each character's last saved reply without repeating effects. Direct questions report current recruitment blockers; fresh local recruitment of Cabral, Dorrego and Paroissien is corrected. Five simulation cases, one component case and live quest replay/save checks cover the change.
requirements.acceptance: Player-wounded contacts now persistently refuse cooperation; named injury and death reach recruitment records. See [civilian consequences](civilian-consequences.md). Other failed approaches, personality/reputation effects and quest failures remain incomplete. Some special contacts currently use an existing generic period portrait.

requirements.requirement: Giving a carried object can complete a local interaction. G75-95; M7-8,25,27.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Partial**: the Retiro clothing errand now uses two physical ponchos. Selecting a carried garment and clicking its recipient transfers one exact object, with legal approach, visibility and availability checks. NPC ownership, item identity, partial delivery, full saves and reentry persist. Selected pocket, hand and worn items now use direct NPC offers, with contact-time acceptance/refusal, portrait replies and automatic quest progress. The first poncho starts the errand; the second rewards once without confirmation. See [selected NPC gifts](selected-npc-gifts.md) for current validation and [carried deliveries](carried-quest-deliveries.md) for the earlier held-item flow.
requirements.acceptance: Tucumán now accepts three physically carried dressings through selected single or partial-batch offers. Excess and wrong items are refused, exact custody survives saves/reentry, the notebook tracks acknowledged quantities, and the loyalty reward occurs once. All 49 focused checks, type checking and the build pass; live partial delivery, excess refusal, cursor return, completion and reload/notebook checks also pass. See [medical delivery](physical-medical-delivery.md). Extend physical giving to other suitable portable quest goods and NPC responses. The bulk powder and cavalry-supply errands still consume campaign resources.

requirements.requirement: Quests include exploration, deliveries, rescue/escort, and branching local consequences. G75-106.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Partial**: three errands and authored San Lorenzo/Yatasto progression. Accepted errands now fail permanently when their contact has a newly acknowledged death. The campaign log records the failure once; partial delivered objects remain with the contact, completed rewards remain credited, and saves require a matching death receipt. See [quest failures](quest-failures.md).
requirements.acceptance: Jujuy now has a local escort entity with adjacent follow/wait and leader-change dialogue, real civilian movement, a physical western-exit destination, required territorial control, saved orders, death failure and a one-time reward. Live arrival and reload/notebook verification pass; see [escort gameplay](escort-gameplay.md). Expand optional resolutions, broader consequences and escape destinations. Do not copy Arulco's story into the historical setting.

requirements.requirement: Surrender, capture, imprisonment, and rescue are distinct from death or rout. G66-68.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Partial**: mobile rout, trapped surrender, physical departure, field capture, inaccessible captive gear/ammunition, contract pause and release after recapture have separate records and tests. The established-area route retains actual deaths and captures at Tucumán and in a coastal defeat. Paid relief squads defeat the persistent enemies and release their prisoners with actual wounds, equipment and remaining contract time. A dropped-gun release regression preserves loose ammunition without inventing personal loading. See [northern route](northern-route.md).
requirements.acceptance: Physical detainees now retain tactical wounds, first aid, death and save receipts. Able guards can provide finite care using confiscated dressings during elapsed strategic time; both sector-recapture rescue routes pass. See [detention care](detention-gameplay.md). Paid physical release, finite following, adjacent wait/follow orders, replacement leadership, saved failed attempts and distinct recapture identities now pass focused and live control checks. Joint safe-exit rescue now restores remaining service at the actual destination and leaves confiscated equipment for later physical pickup. Controlled live exit/return/reload and simulation checks pass. An unaided rescue approach, self-directed escape, detention choices and their narrative consequences remain open. Coastal defense victory now releases prisoners after the last local enemy group is defeated, including sectors that retained patriot ownership. A returning-squad regression covers actual capture, travel reversal and encounter entry, then a scripted victory report isolates settlement. It verifies retained wounds, ammunition, saves, duplicate-report rejection and no release while another local group remains. This does not establish a playable prison scene or combat balance.

requirements.requirement: Tactical changes, local gear, personnel condition, and unfinished battles survive return and save/load. G19-20,64-66.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Implemented** for current state: `world.js`, `save.js`, schema validators and integration tests.
requirements.acceptance: Every added awareness, trap, attachment, inventory slot, assignment, enemy group, and interrupt state needs a validated migration and a reload continuation test. Large browser/export saves now use lossless terrain palettes after a real final-battle save exceeded 5 MB. The file limit remains, with bounded expansion and exact state validation. Older saves, malformed compact input, deterministic continuation and live reloads are verified; see [compact saves](compact-saves.md). Ordinary issued guns now retain paid unfinished reload work through campaign returns, save/load, and redeployment. A live controlled return/reload check and the fresh northern route pass; see [campaign reload work](campaign-reload-work.md). Every held gun now retains its actual load on campaign return, including ordinary full and empty guns. Exact stock/held accounting, repeated return/save/reentry, exhausted firing, armory swaps and the fresh route through Mendoza pass; see [persistent gun loads](campaign-gun-loads.md). Initial issue and finite reserve replenishment remain separate strategic supply behavior. Stationed artillery now consumes depot stock once and retains identity, position, ownership, load, reserves and unfinished loading through reports and reentry. Thirteen new tests and a live purchase/victory/exhaustion/resupply/reload/save route pass; see [stationed artillery](stationed-artillery.md). Deployed guns can now be recovered into cart or flotilla convoys and arrive in a local depot with exact identity, ammunition and unfinished loading. Local crew, secured terrain, route and capacity rules apply; interrupted delivery, redeployment and save validation pass. Live dispatch, reload/resume and arrival retain the gun state. See [artillery transport](artillery-transport.md). Tactical convoy ambushes and disassembled high-pass transport remain outside this implementation.

requirements.requirement: A complete campaign can be played from a clean start through the actual tactical rules. G13-18,59,75-106.
requirements.historicalClaim: **Partial; current integration check, 27 September:** the fresh paid route passes the opening, northern battles, Córdoba medical recovery and its actual counterattack, survivor reunification and a Tucumán victory. Battles retain replay, save and permanent-casualty assertions. The next care helper fails because a wounded location has no fit local medic. The current broad run has 2,944 passed, four failed and three skipped of 2,951 checks. See [current evidence](evidence/campaign-progress-cordoba-2026-09-27.json) and [remaining work](gameplay-follow-up-2026-09-27.md). Earlier coastal, mountain and final northern checkpoints remain historical evidence, not current clean-start acceptance.
requirements.acceptance: Complete real medical relief, then revalidate the remaining route and actual ending with paid supplies and real casualties. Established Córdoba recapture and physical Humahuaca rescue also fail. Scripted victory reports isolate subsystem settlement; they do not prove campaign playability or general balance.
